method: Fresh exact ARM64 Mach-O disassembly using audit_hud_macho LLVM helpers and exact_disassemble boundary masking; actual branch/argument tracing against complete current patch reconstruction, raw modal table decode, stub and identical-code alias resolution. Watcher symbol presence/call list not treated as proof.

checks.obligation: Exact native Knife type and original vc guards
actual_branch_argument_flow: ED_mesh_knife_modal_type rejects null type, OPTYPE_MACRO bit3 and nonempty type macro first; it compares invoke/modal/cancel slots to exact addresses0x101c33afc/0x101c33df4/0x101c345fc.

ED_mesh_knife_modal_origin clears all48 output bytes before checking op; rejects opm at0x90, op macro first at0x80, missing customdata at0x60, and inlines the same type guards. Only then it loads original vc scene/view_layer/v3d/region/rv3d/obedit at customdata offsets0x28/0x30/0x50/0x48/0x60/0x40; all six must be nonnull before copied output publication.

checks.obligation: Private action creates clean semantic native modal event
actual_branch_argument_flow: ED_mesh_knife_modal_action returns PASS_THROUGH8 for missing C/event/op/customdata or macro/type mismatch. It constructs the complete176-byte wmEvent from zero stores at sp0..0xa0, then sets only prev_type/prev_val from source event word0x10, EVT_MODAL_MAP0x5022, native val1 Cancel or2 Confirm, xy/mval16 bytes from source offset0x14.

Confirm bool is tested at0x101c347ac; cinc makes val2 when true and val1 when false. x0=C/x1=original op remain intact; x2 becomes stack event before direct call0x101c347c8 to knifetool_modal. Keyboard UTF8/customdata and other old packet fields are not copied.

checks.obligation: Actual mapped native Confirm and Cancel cases and resource exit
actual_branch_argument_flow: Compiled modal checks EVT_MODAL_MAP0x5022 at0x101c33fcc..fd4, subtracts1 from val and indexes19-byte table0x1051f29fa. Raw binary decode saved separately resolves Cancel1 through byte54 to0x101c340e4 and Confirm2 through byte0 to0x101c3400c.

Cancel tags original region redraw at0x101c340e4 and branches to0x101c34104: native exit_ex(op.customdata), customdata=null, status text clear, return CANCELLED2. Confirm saves totkvert from0x354, redraws original region, calls knifetool_finish(op), then exit_ex and nulls customdata/status. It returns FINISHED4 when totkvert is nonzero, otherwise CANCELLED2.

knifetool_finish iterates captured objects, calls native finish_single_pre, editmesh/select-mode flush and EDBM_update. exit_ex conditionally restores native cursor/draw callback, frees native Knife pools/stacks/hashes/arena/BVH/arrays and releases kcd through the registered memory-free slot. This is native function/call-order evidence, not a proof of all geometry or allocator behavior.

checks.obligation: Registration-before-bind and fresh original ownership reconstruction
actual_branch_argument_flow: wm_ipad_knife_window_manager is inlined: it walks G_MAIN.wm and BLI_findindex(manager.windows,win), rejecting absence or a second containing manager before dereferencing window state. owner_read independently repeats this scan; no absent standalone symbol is counted as missing proof.

WM_event_add_modal_handler_ex builds handler type3, original op and area/region context; insertion is BLI_insertlinkafter at0x100b585d8 or BLI_addhead at0x100b585e8. Only after insertion does inlined bind call owner_read(win,new_handler,original_area,original_region,true,out) at0x100b58624 (w4=1). Successful output is copied184 bytes into handler+0x178; failure leaves its zero initialized receipt.

owner_read first validates manager UID/runtime/registered handler membership/type3/not DO_FREE/not fileselect/context window/nonnull op. For reread w4=false it invokes lifetime_matches(op,handler.saved_lifetime) before op type/customdata reads. It looks up the registered MESH_OT_knife_tool type, requires nonzero type lifetime and exact native type guard, then matches op.type and rejects opm.

Fresh scan validates active screen membership+UID, original numeric area membership/View3D/context area, region membership/window type/runtime/visible/regiondata; original vc region,rv3d,v3d match before active scene/layer/object/mesh identity membership, UIDs and edit-mode checks. It copies the23-value tuple including original handler/op/type lifetimes only after these guards.

checks.obligation: Input capture, presentation presence, and region resolver stay distinct
actual_branch_argument_flow: capture validates C.manager and C.window against fresh manager/window membership. It skips DO_FREE entries, rejects unrelated active UI handlers; transparency requires same area, no popup, live HUD region and UI_ipad_knife_hud_ui_handler approval. Every operator handler must have a valid same-area saved receipt; owner_read false and complete184-byte memcmp equality are required. A second owner rejects.

present uses the same original owner reconstruction/equality and rejects duplicate matching owners, but ignores unrelated/nonmatching entries for presentation. This does not grant strict input authority.

owner_region first checks receipt validity, fresh manager/C/window and active-screen membership, then resolves area numerically from live list. include_blocked selects present; false selects capture. Complete184-byte equality precedes fresh region-list address resolution. Saved numeric addresses are compared to registered members instead of converted to old native pointers for reads.

checks.obligation: Operator lifetime lookup and free invalidation actual data flow
actual_branch_argument_flow: lifetime_id hashes op address as a value into map0x107ef3320; a match returns node lifetime0x18. Absent nonnull op increments counter0x107ef3348 unless UINT64_MAX, and emplaces address+new lifetime. lifetime_matches looks up the same map and compares node0x18 to supplied lifetime; no op pointee read occurs in the matcher.

WM_operator_free stores op to sp+8, passes map address0x107ef3320 and &stack_key to0x100b43cfc before any object cleanup/free. That target has six same-address LLVM aliases including the actual const-wmOperator lifetime-map erase; the nanovdb name in disassembly is a merged-code alias. Body hashes key from[x1], compares node key0x10 and removes the matched node before return. This resolves the alias with exact address, arguments, and body; no global map/heap completeness claim.

checks.obligation: Single-use release scope queues only copied request and owned event
actual_branch_argument_flow: Scope TLS descriptor0x106d86b60 is symbol wm_ipad_knife_ui_scope, shared by event loop, scope_active and queue. scope_active is inlined in queue: C, receipt valid slots, generation0xb8 and serial0xc0 must be nonzero, then owner_region(C,current_window,scope.owner,false) must resolve.

Queue requires release byte0xd0==1, queued0xd1==0, full184-byte scope-owner equality and action enum1/2. On admission it stores queued=1 at0x100b50d14 before allocation/enqueue. A192-byte request is zero constructed; all184 owner bytes and the action byte at0xb8 are copied from values, without borrowing callback/operator storage.

WM_event_add is inlined here: it allocates a separate176-byte event, writes type0x208/val0, copies scope xy, clears other event fields, writes custom7/free1/request pointer, and appends to current_window.runtime.event_queue with BLI_addtail at0x100b50e14. There is no native terminal dispatch in queue; UI returns before the later private event branch can run.

checks.obligation: Private request resolver validates structure then fresh identity
actual_branch_argument_flow: Resolver zeroes all outputs first. It requires event/type0x208/custom7/nonnull customdata/nonzero customdata_free, copies192 request bytes to local stack, and allows action1/2 only. owner_region with include_blocked=false must succeed before area/handler resolution.

It scans the fresh active screen area list for saved area value and fresh window modal list for saved handler value; only live handler type3/not DO_FREE can be returned. It does not dereference request.saved_operator or cast a saved handler address to a live pointer. Existing owner reconstruction already matched op/type/context/lifetime and full saved receipt.

checks.obligation: Private packet entry is consumed on success and structural/stale rejection
actual_branch_argument_flow: wm_event_do_handlers tests type0x208 at0x100b54e44. Resolve failure branches directly to0x100b54ec4; success passes C,&win.modalhandlers,fresh_handler,event,null,null,false into wm_handler_operator_call at0x100b54e94, then reaches the same branch. There w24=return|3 sets BREAK/HANDLED in both cases.

This skips ordinary modal dispatcher0x100b554b4. At0x100b54f34 bitmask3 prevents panels handling, and0x100b54fc0 combines flags before0x100b54fc4 tests BREAK and bypasses lower region/area/window input dispatch. Normal consumed event reaches queue unlink0x100b55844 then free_last_handled0x100b55850.

wm_handler_operator_call defensively resolves again before reading handler.op, compares returned handler to the supplied handler, and returns flags3 on mismatch/rejection. Structurally malformed or stale internally owned request packets therefore do not become ordinary tool input. This is not a memory-safety guarantee for a forged arbitrary customdata address.

checks.obligation: Original context direct action bypasses modal keymap translation
actual_branch_argument_flow: After fresh-handler check, wm_handler_operator_call reads original live handler.op/type and retains ordinary interface-lock/modal checks. For private action w25=1 it uses resolver area+region via setters0x100b51bf8/0x100b51c04; generic handler context fallback is on the other branch.

Native private branch calls wm_region_mouse_co, loads copied request.action, compares to Confirm enum1 and passes bool in w3 with x0=C/x1=original op/x2=event to ED_mesh_knife_modal_action at0x100b51f6c. It sets modalkeymap_started=false; generic begin and ot.modal indirect call0x100b51f8c..fa0 are bypassed. The private helper maps that bool to native Confirm2/Cancel1; it does not mutate a keyboard/mouse packet into a terminal.

checks.obligation: Native status goes through ordinary completion, Undo selection and handler disposal
actual_branch_argument_flow: Ordinary Undo depth increment0x100b51ed4..ee4 precedes action and matching-manager decrement0x100b51fb8..fd0 follows. Context-window equality guard0x100b51fd4..fe0 precedes ordinary status cleanup.

Status FINISHED bit2 branches to wm_operator_finished(C,op,false,true,has_undo,has_register) at0x100b520f4; CANCELLED bit1 uses WM_operator_free(op)0x100b520a4. Both null handler.op0x100b520f8. Native Confirm can return CANCELLED for no changes, preserving Blender native behavior.

wm_operator_finished retains normal native Undo/Register decision path including ED_undo_push_op0x100b5c56c and operator register0x100b5c61c or normal free0x100b5c698. This verifies selection of native completion; it is not a universal Undo/history rollback proof.

After normal context handling/gizmo update, terminal mask6 disables cursor grab, unlinks original handler from supplied modal list0x100b52164 and releases it through mem_freeN_ex at0x100b5217c. wm_event_free_handler is inlined at that site; its standalone5-instruction body uses the same free slot.

checks.obligation: Queued request disposal clears custom payload and queued window cleanup frees it
actual_branch_argument_flow: wm_event_custom_free is inlined. free_last_handled checks current event customdata and customdata_free then selects non-drag custom7 through direct MEM_freeN0x100b56490. It clears custom/free word at0x80 and pointer0x88 before storing event_last_handled; later event disposal cannot reuse that request.

wm_event_free_all similarly pops queued events and frees owned non-drag request customdata before event release. This gives bounded handled-event and pending-window-queue cleanup evidence; it does not enumerate every allocator path or prove arbitrary corrupt payload validity.

checks.obligation: WM HUD dispatch boundary publishes and clears the admitted UI scope
actual_branch_argument_flow: wm_ipad_knife_hud_dispatch is inlined in wm_event_do_handlers. Tagged dispatch requires UI_ipad_knife_hud_generation; tagged press additionally rechecks hit generation/owner/HUD and retires stale proof on mismatch. This WM review treats UI receipt/hit/geometry implementation as the independent UI reviewer boundary.

After live area+HUD list membership, it saves previous area/region numeric values and Main, sets current original area+HUD, computes region mouse coords and copies owner/generation/serial/xy into the actual TLS scope0x100b55de8..e38. Release authority is exactly LEFTMOUSE1/KM_RELEASE2 and POINTER_CANCEL bit6 clear at0x100b55e3c..e6c.

It calls UI_ipad_knife_hud_event_handle at0x100b55e78, then immediately zeros all scope fields including queued/release bytes at0x100b55e80..ea0. Context restoration rescans manager/window/Main/screen/area/region membership0x100b55ea4..56084 and clears click/drag flags0x100b56088. No native terminal is called in this scope flow.

resolved_inlining_and_aliases.resolution: Inlined fresh manager list and window membership scan in owner_read/capture/present/region/eventloop.
Inlined in wm_event_do_handlers; actual TLS publication/UI call/clear/restore scopes reviewed.
Inlined generic-only0x100b51fe8..52018; private w25=0 bypasses this block.
Inlined in free_last_handled and free_all; custom7 follows non-drag direct MEM_freeN branch.
Inlined queue event allocation/copy/BLI_addtail, compared to fresh standalone scope.
Inlined terminal free at0x100b52168..17c through same mem_freeN_ex slot.
LLVM misleading zlibVersion text labels are ignored; __stubs/indirect-symbols maps0x104b72368 to _memcmp. Owner equality uses184-byte length0xb8, return must equal0.

Merged six-alias target0x100b43cfc includes actual const wmOperator map erase. Arguments use same global map0x107ef3320 and original stack key; body compares hashed key, removes matching node before operator free.

boundary_to_ui_review: WM calls UI_ipad_knife_hud_event_handle with admitted scope; UI reviewer owns callback, button, presentation receipt, geometry and hierarchy internals. This report covers scope publish/clear and queued native consumer.
limits: Bounded manual branch/call/argument review, not exhaustive global CFG, all reachable state, scheduling or reentrancy proof.
No global heap, allocator completeness, hostile arbitrary pointer packet safety, or general callback lifetime guarantee.
Structural malformed/stale internally owned request packets are guarded; forged nonnull customdata addresses cannot be validated as memory-safe by these guards.
Native Undo path selection is verified; geometry correctness, history semantics and generic Cancel universal rollback are not proved.
UI helper internals, compositor pixels, layout, UIKit/Pencil timing and hardware/device acceptance are outside this reviewer scope.
Preserved HUD launch checker result is separate. This report neither suppresses its raw failure nor substitutes for root independent stack-spill reconciliation.
Private crash resources and exclusions were not changed; no production, tests, build or workflow edits, dispatches or device operations were performed.
